info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Operational Actions Management API
info.description: The Operational Actions Management API enables organizations to streamline internal network operations related to IT management. This API provides functionalities for managing various operational actions essential for maintaining and optimizing network performance. Ideal for system administrators and IT professionals, this endpoint allows users to initiate specific operational tasks that can enhance operational efficiency. Typical use cases include executing network configurations, facilitating updates, and tracking task completions within the IT infrastructure.

post.summary: Create an operational action for internal network management.
post.description: This endpoint allows you to create a new operational action related to the internal network management. It facilitates the execution of actions that enhance network performance and reliability. Ensure that all required parameters are included in the request.
